_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. Pinned to commit SHAs, not a branch name, as of 0.1.9 -- a branch pin silently picks up whatever that branch's HEAD is at tag-push time, which twice produced a release missing work that had already been committed to the branch but not accounted for when the tag was cut. A SHA pin makes exactly what's bundled explicit and reviewable in this file's own diff. pine-lang bumped to master's 0.38.1 (exposes group-by columns in the build response) -- pinned by SHA rather than a tag since pine-lang's own release process doesn't tag releases. beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.48.1 (experimental interactive view, unified visual design, and a follow-up fix for a next/font build failure found while cutting this very desktop release).
